get_collate_fn: create a PyTorch DataLoader collate function that batches data with text, landmarks, and utterance keys into GPU tensors
list_to_tensor: convert a multi-dimensional ragged list into a padded PyTorch tensor and return a corresponding mask tensor
get_max_dimensions: calculate the maximum dimensions of a multi-dimensional list of arbitrary depth recursively
fill: recursively fill a PyTorch tensor with values from a multi-dimensional array and set a mask tensor
to_variable: convert tensors, lists, or dicts of tensors into PyTorch Variables and move them to CUDA
